Problem management and root-cause analysis Identify recurring incidents and underlying systemic problems. Lead or contribute to root-cause analysis. Recommend permanent corrective and preventive actions. Change and release support Assess the impact of fixes, configuration changes, and ERP updates. Perform functional/system testing and coordinate business validation when appropriate. Support deployments and post-deployment verification. Monitoring and operational support Monitor critical ERP processes, scheduled jobs, integrations, and interfaces. Investigate failures proactively where monitoring is available. Ensure critical business processes are restored within agreed service levels. Ticket and SLA management Own assigned incidents through resolution rather than simply forwarding them. Prioritize according to severity and business impact. Maintain clear, accurate ticket documentation and regular communication with users. Knowledge management Document solutions, known errors, troubleshooting procedures, and recurring issues. Create knowledge articles that enable Level 1 to resolve more incidents independently. Share knowledge with other ERP support team members. Business and IT coordination Act as a bridge between business users and technical teams. Translate business symptoms into technical/functional requirements for specialists. Communicate technical findings in language understandable to business stakeholders. CRITICAL CAPABILITIES Excellent written and verbal communication skills. ERP Functional Expertise Strong understanding of core ERP processes and assigned functional areas (BaanIV, Infor LN, or Microsoft Dynamics AX 2012). Ability to understand how transactions flow across modules. Ability to distinguish process, configuration, master-data, and system issues. Advanced Troubleshooting & Root-Cause Analysis Systematic investigation of complex incidents. Identify symptom vs. root cause. Analyze application errors, logs, jobs, interfaces, and transaction history. Develop and validate workarounds when immediate resolution is unavailable. Integration & End-to-End Process Understanding Understand ERP interfaces with upstream and downstream applications. Trace transactions across systems. Determine where a failure occurred and which team/application owns it. Understand dependencies between ERP, middleware, databases, reporting, and external systems. Incident Ownership & Prioritization Take ownership from escalation through resolution. Assess business impact, urgency, and priority. Drive resolution across multiple technical or functional teams. Maintain clear communication with impacted users and stakeholders. Technical Analysis Ability to investigate application logs, batch processes, queues, interfaces, and error messages. Basic understanding of databases and data structures. Ability to perform data analysis and queries where appropriate. Understand enough of the ERP technical architecture to engage effectively with developers and infrastructure teams. Requirements EDUCATION: Bachelor's Degree/College Diploma in a technical discipline (Engineering or IT related) EXPERIENCE: 3+ years of experience as an ERP application support or ERP analyst preferred. 3+ years of process improvement, data, or technology project experience would be a strong asset. 2+ years of experience working with BaanIV, Infor LN or Microsoft Dynamics AX 2012. El ecosistema de tecnología financiera y pagos digitales está transformando la economía, y en nuestra compañía estamos en el centro de esa evolución. ¿Cuál será tu misión? Gestionar el soporte técnico y acompañamiento a clientes de LATAM que requieran solicitudes con redes de procesamiento, adquirentes, integraciones de medios de pago. Análisis de distintos componentes de la pasarela de pago Payzen para implementaciones en distintas partes del mundo con especial énfasis en Latam y Colombia. Our job is to make it possible to run machine learning and AI agents directly on real-time data — without customers having to stitch together a separate stack to do it. We own our products end to end, from the user-facing API down to the serving layer that runs inference in production, and we work closely with the broader platform teams whose systems we build on top of. It's a high-ownership, high-autonomy environment: small enough that what you build ships and matters, broad enough that the problems are genuinely hard. About The Role As a Software Developer on the AI team, you will take ownership of the infrastructure that enables our "in-place, at-scale" AI value proposition. You aren't just building a feature; you are architecting the systems that allow customers to run complex inference and AI agents directly on streaming data, eliminating the need to move data to external stacks. We are looking for developers who thrive on the technical complexity of large-scale distributed systems. You will tackle deep infrastructure challenges across networking, compute, and security to ensure our AI capabilities are as reliable as the core data plane itself. Preferred Technical And Professional Experience What Gives You an Edge: Exposure to model serving, LLM/agent infrastructure, or streaming data systems. Note - You don't need a background in ML research or model training — this role is about building and operating the platform that serves AI reliably at scale, not inventing the models.

This position combines hands-on system expertise with close collaboration across finance and technology teams to deliver reliable, scalable, and compliant solutions supporting international business operations. You will contribute to both operational excellence and strategic transformation initiatives, helping modernize financial processes and improve the overall user experience. Your tasks Managing and enhancing finance-related ERP functionalities, ensuring stable day-to-day operations and continuous improvements Collaborating with business stakeholders to identify process optimization opportunities and translating them into system solutions Leading discussions around financial processes, including period-end activities, intercompany transactions, asset accounting, tax-related processes and financial reporting Gathering, analyzing and validating business requirements, performing gap assessments and supporting solution design activities Participating in implementation projects, testing cycles, deployments and post-go-live support Ensuring compliance with governance, audit and control standards while supporting cross-functional integrations and business initiatives Requirements Minimum 5 years of technical hands-on experience as an SAP Finance Consultant, including configuration, support, and enhancement activities within finance modules Strong expertise in core financial processes such as general ledger accounting, fixed assets, multi-currency operations, period-end closing, intercompany accounting, and statutory reporting Solid understanding of accounting principles and the integration of finance systems with related business functions Experience in requirements gathering, business process analysis, testing, user support, and solution documentation Proven ability to work independently in a dynamic environment while effectively collaborating with cross-functional and international teams Fluent English with strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills Job no. review_candidates.title: Software Engineer (Chinese Speaking)
review_candidates.description: Brief Overview Hai Robotics is a leading innovator of logistics robotics solutions. Our sophisticated systems are designed to optimise supply chain operations across various industries, with the goal of offering cost-effective, efficient, and sustainable solutions. With our robots, we reduce our customers' storage footprint and operating costs, improve warehouse productivity and maximize workflow efficiencies with increased speed & order accuracy. Key Responsibilities As a Software Engineer within Hai, you will leverage your expertise in Linux, MySQL, and programming languages such as Java, C#, or C++ to design, configure, and troubleshoot software systems. In Addition, You Will Conduct software designs and configuration capabilities. Take ownership of software development-related content. Estimate development requirements, timing, quality and quantity of resources needed to successfully implement projects. Interact with customers to conduct tests, intercept and prevent potential risks or suggest solutions to achieve project success. Who are we looking for? You Have a Knack For Working In Fast-paced Environments And Are Eager To Learn And Take Ownership Of Your Work. In Addition, You Ideally Have A minumum Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or related field. Both fresh graduate and 2-4 years of experience as a Software Engineer or in a related occupation, ideally in integrated supply chain and logistics systems solutions, are welcome! Programming experience in Java, C#, SQL, C++ or similar languages, ideally with some experience in scripting and coding. Knowledge and understanding of Linux and MySQL according to operational standards, and ability to execute commands and troubleshoot/fix bugs. Knowledge of control system tools such as Git or SVN. Strong learning and receptiveness, able to adapt quickly to new environments, willing to accept challenges and excellent teamwork spirit. The openness to travel around 20% to various unanticipated locations. Strong fluency in English and Chinese; Chinese is a must You are based in the Netherlands. We are a recognised sponsor, so we can sponsor your visa if necessary. Hai-lights We offer a dynamic and innovative working environment in a very committed organisation, with the following perks: A competitive salary based on your experience Performance based bonuses 24 days of holiday 8% holiday allowance Commuting allowance Work laptop and phone The opportunity to contribute to a young, growing company, shaping its success and your career About Us Hai Robotics helps businesses unlock smarter, more flexible warehouse operations.Founded in 2016, the company is redefining warehouse automation through adaptable automated storage and retrieval solutions designed to evolve alongside operational needs. After pioneering Automated Case-handling Mobile Robot (ACR) technology, Hai Robotics introduced a modular approach that helps businesses scale faster, optimize space, and respond more effectively to changing demand. By combining robotics, software, and intelligent system design, Hai Robotics enables organizations to create more agile and resilient operations without the complexity traditionally associated with warehouse automation. Today, the company supports customers across more than 40 countries in industries including retail, e-commerce, healthcare, manufacturing, 3PL, and apparel.With a global network of offices and partners, Hai Robotics works side-by-side with customers to solve operational challenges and build systems designed for long-term performance.

review_candidates.title: Data Scientist
review_candidates.description: Department: Data Insights & Artificial Intelligence Location: Cairo, Egypt Purpose of the Role We are looking for a Data Scientist with strong analytical and technical skills who is excited to solve real-world business problems using data, advanced analytics and machine learning. In this role, you will contribute to the development and deployment of analytics solutions across a complex, multi-market environment, with a strong focus on route-to-market and commercial effectiveness. You will work closely with other data scientists, data engineers, product teams and business stakeholders to translate business challenges into practical, scalable data-driven solutions deployed across 29 markets. This is a hands-on role suited for someone who enjoys working with large datasets, developing machine learning solutions, and collaborating with both technical and business teams to create measurable business impact. YOUR NEW KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: Collaborate with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to understand business challenges and translate them into analytical and data science problems. Contribute to the end-to-end development of advanced analytics and machine learning solutions, from data exploration and modelling through testing, deployment and continuous improvement. Develop and implement machine learning and statistical models to extract insights, identify patterns, predict outcomes and support data-driven decision making. Analyse large and complex datasets to identify opportunities, evaluate hypotheses and improve existing solutions. Develop and test proof-of-concept solutions and support their evolution into scalable, production-ready products. Work with data engineers, other data scientists and business experts to build robust and maintainable analytical solutions. Monitor and evaluate model and solution performance and contribute to their continuous improvement. Write clean, efficient and well-structured Python and PySpark code following team development standards and best practices. Participate in Agile/SAFe ways of working and collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams. Contribute ideas and analytical approaches that can improve existing solutions or address new business opportunities. ARE THESE YOUR SECRET INGREDIENTS? 2+ years of hands-on experience in data science, machine learning, advanced analytics or a related role. Strong proficiency in Python , with practical experience using PySpark for data processing and analytics. Good understanding of machine learning, statistical modelling and experimentation , and the ability to apply appropriate techniques to real-world problems. Experience working with large datasets, including data preparation, feature engineering, model development and evaluation. Familiarity with distributed data processing and cloud-based data platforms; experience with Azure and Databricks is an advantage. Experience developing machine learning or analytical solutions beyond one-off analysis, with exposure to production or operational environments considered an advantage. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with curiosity to explore data and understand the underlying business problem. Ability to write clear, maintainable and efficient code and follow software development and data science best practices. Good collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to explain analytical concepts and results to both technical and non-technical audiences. Ability to work effectively as part of a team, manage assigned priorities and collaborate with colleagues across different functions and markets. Experience in CPG, retail or commercial analytics such as customer segmentation, assortment recommendation or sales effectiveness is an advantage. BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, Mathematics or another related quantitative field. ABOUT YOUR NEW TEAM: We are a family of 33 thousand engaged people. Each and every one of us is the secret ingredient of Coca-Cola HBC – one of the world’s largest bottlers and partner of The Coca-Cola Company. Our everyday mission is to delight over 715 million consumers by offering a choice of over 100 iconic global and favorite local brands in the moments that matter, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. We are a truly empowered and talented team that drives superior results by winning and learning every day in 29 countries, across 3 continents. Our success comes from us working together as one to make a positive difference for the local communities we serve. AT COCA-COLA HBC, DIVERSITY HELPS US THRIVE Including and celebrating different people and opinions is embedded in our growth story. We are committed to fostering diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve, and to creating an inclusive environment where everyone’s unique perspectives are valued and heard. By constantly building a diverse and inclusive workplace, we enrich our decision-making and provide ever more innovative solutions and shared value.

review_candidates.title: Développeur Backend Python & Cloud GCP Expert (H/F)
review_candidates.description: Dans le cadre de l’évolution d’une solution B2B basée sur un bot conversationnel , nous recherchons un Développeur Backend Python & Cloud GCP Expert pour renforcer l’équipe. Vous interviendrez sur la reprise et l’évolution d’une solution existante, avec un fort enjeu autour du développement backend Python, des API, du Cloud GCP et de l’Infrastructure as Code . Missions Reprendre en main une base de code et une infrastructure existantes. Concevoir et développer de nouvelles fonctionnalités backend en Python. Développer et sécuriser des API REST / Webhooks et leurs intégrations avec le SI. Concevoir et faire évoluer des conversations sur une solution de bot conversationnel. Déployer et maintenir les infrastructures Cloud via Terraform. Participer à l’industrialisation des déploiements et de la CI/CD. Diagnostiquer et corriger les anomalies détectées en recette et en production. Mettre en place et maintenir les tests unitaires et d’intégration. Contribuer à l’amélioration de l’architecture et de la qualité du code. Documenter les composants applicatifs, l’infrastructure et les flux techniques. Participer aux rituels Agile et aux travaux d’estimation et de conception technique. Environnement technique Backend : Python 3.x, FastAPI, Flask Cloud : GCP, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, IAM, Secret Manager Bot / IA conversationnelle : Dialogflow CX API : REST, Webhooks, JSON, OpenAPI Infrastructure : Terraform, Flux CD CI/CD & Conteneurisation : Docker, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Cloud Build Sécurité & API Management : Keycloak, Gravitee Base de données : Firestore Outils : Git, Jira, Confluence Profil candidat: 5 ans d’expérience minimum en développement backend Python. Expertise confirmée en Python / Backend. Solide expérience sur GCP et ses services cloud. Maîtrise de Terraform et des pratiques Infrastructure as Code. Expérience significative dans la conception et l’intégration d’API sécurisées. Bonne maîtrise des pratiques CI/CD, Docker et tests automatisés. Capacité à reprendre rapidement un existant et à intervenir dans un environnement technique complexe. Une expérience sur des bots conversationnels, des solutions collaboratives serait un plus. Qualités attendues Autonomie et capacité d’adaptation. Esprit d’analyse et sens du diagnostic. Rigueur et pragmatisme. Bon relationnel et excellente communication. Force de proposition et sens du service. Capacité à collaborer efficacement avec les équipes techniques et métiers. Télétravail : majoritairement à distance, avec déplacements ponctuels à prévoir selon les besoins de la mission.
